title: Current Affairs
parentNote: This unit covers current events, important people, and recent happenings. Good for general awareness!
learnBullets: Know about **important people** in India today
learnItFirst:
**1. Important People in India**

| Position | Current Person |
|----------|---------------|
| President | Droupadi Murmu |
| Prime Minister | Narendra Modi |
| Chief Justice | (Changes periodically) |

**2. India's Recent Achievements**

- **Chandrayaan-3**: India's spacecraft landed on Moon's South Pole (2023)
- **G20 Summit**: India hosted G20 as President (2023)
- **Neeraj Chopra**: Won Olympic gold in Javelin (2020 Olympics)
- **P.V. Sindhu**: Olympic medallist in Badminton

**3. Important International Days**

| Day | Date |
|-----|------|
| World Environment Day | 5th June |
| International Yoga Day | 21st June |
| World Health Day | 7th April |
| World Water Day | 22nd March |

**4. Stay Updated!**

- Read children's newspapers
- Watch news for kids
- Ask parents about important events

questions.content: Who is the Prime Minister of India?
questions.why: Narendra Modi is the current Prime Minister of India

questions.content: Who is the first woman President of India?
questions.why: Pratibha Patil was the first woman President of India (2007-2012)

questions.content: International Yoga Day is celebrated on ___.
questions.why: International Yoga Day is celebrated on 21st June every year

questions.content: Which Indian mission landed on the Moon's South Pole?
questions.why: Chandrayaan-3 successfully landed on the Moon's South Pole in 2023

questions.content: Who is the current President of India?
questions.why: Droupadi Murmu is the current (and first tribal woman) President of India

questions.content: World Health Day is celebrated on ___.
questions.why: World Health Day is celebrated on 7th April every year

questions.content: India hosted which major world summit in 2023?
questions.why: India hosted the G20 Summit in 2023 as the G20 President

questions.content: World Water Day is celebrated on ___.
questions.why: World Water Day is celebrated on 22nd March every year

questions.content: Who won India's first Olympic gold in athletics?
questions.why: Neeraj Chopra won India's first Olympic gold in athletics (Javelin throw, 2020 Olympics)

questions.content: Which planet did India's Mangalyaan mission go to?
questions.why: Mangalyaan (Mars Orbiter Mission) went to Mars in 2014

questions.content: Which country will host the 2028 Summer Olympics?
questions.why: Los Angeles, USA will host the 2028 Summer Olympics

questions.content: World Environment Day is celebrated on ___.
questions.why: World Environment Day is celebrated on 5th June every year

questions.content: ISRO is India's space agency. ISRO stands for ___.
questions.why: ISRO stands for Indian Space Research Organisation

questions.content: Earth Day is celebrated on ___.
questions.why: Earth Day is celebrated on 22nd April every year

questions.content: Which city hosted the 2024 Summer Olympics?
questions.why: Paris, France hosted the 2024 Summer Olympics

questions.content: World Book Day is celebrated on ___.
questions.why: World Book Day is celebrated on 23rd April every year

questions.content: Who is known as the 'Missile Man of India'?
questions.why: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam is known as the Missile Man of India

questions.content: International Women's Day is celebrated on ___.
questions.why: International Women's Day is celebrated on 8th March every year

questions.content: Which app is commonly used for video calls and online classes?
questions.why: Zoom and Google Meet are popular apps for video calls and online classes

questions.content: World Television Day is celebrated on ___.
questions.why: World Television Day is celebrated on 21st November

questions.content: Which is India's national space agency?
questions.why: ISRO (Indian Space Research Organisation) is India's space agency

questions.content: International Children's Day is celebrated on ___.
questions.why: Universal Children's Day is on 20th November (India celebrates on 14th November)

questions.content: United Nations Day is celebrated on ___.
questions.why: United Nations Day is celebrated on 24th October every year

questions.content: Which Indian became Miss Universe 2021?
questions.why: Harnaaz Sandhu won Miss Universe 2021, the third Indian to win this title

questions.content: World Teachers' Day is celebrated on ___.
questions.why: World Teachers' Day is on 5th October (India celebrates on 5th September)

questions.content: Which country has the largest population in the world?
questions.why: India became the world's most populous country in 2023

questions.content: World Ozone Day is celebrated on ___.
questions.why: World Ozone Day is celebrated on 16th September

questions.content: Which is the tallest building in the world?
questions.why: Burj Khalifa in Dubai is the tallest building in the world

questions.content: Which is the world's largest statue?
questions.why: Statue of Unity in Gujarat, India is the world's tallest statue (182 meters)

questions.content: World Wildlife Day is celebrated on ___.
questions.why: World Wildlife Day is celebrated on 3rd March every year
